title: TBR set for 120 seconds with OrangeLink instead of 120 minutes
body:
Hardware / Software ;

Samsung A52 5G
AAPS version 3.0.0.2
OrangeLink hardware Version 1.0 with Firmware v3.2
Medtronic Veo 554

Reporting bugs
--------------

Pump sets 120 minutes Temporary Basal rate 0.000 U for 120 minutes-> 
08:14:52.614 [Thread-15922] I/PUMPCOMM: [MedtronicCommunicationManager.setTemporaryBasal():611]: setTBR: Rate: 0.000 U, Duration: 120 min
08:14:54.125 [Thread-15922] I/PUMP: [MedtronicPumpPlugin.setTempBasalAbsolute():761]: MedtronicPumpPlugin::setTempBasalAbsolute - setTBR. Response: true

NS says 120 seconds ->

08:14:54.134 [Thread-15922] D/CORE: [PumpSyncStorage.addTemporaryBasalRateWithTempId():179]: PumpDbEntryTBR: PumpDbEntryTBR(temporaryId=20220705081454, date=1657001694125, pumpType=MEDTRONIC_554_754_VEO, serialNumber=856911, pumpId=null, rate=0.0, isAbsolute=true, durationInSeconds=120, tbrType=NORMAL)
